finalOwner: expansion.browser-host:Shared browser language and semantic host
retirementObligation: Delete throwaway feasibility glue (packages/browser-host probe/worker harness and this receipt's spike notes) when BWH3 adopts the proven seams. The gate runner remains the browser-host-domain profile entry until a later node replaces it.
authority: verter_session VerterHost via crates/verter_wasm wasm_bindgen bindings. packages/browser-host calls that host; it does not implement types, project resolution, mapping or query.

fixture.normalization: symbol identity is {name, kind, isExported} sorted by name then kind; TypeInfo observation is JSON-canonicalized typeExpr from resolveSymbolWithAudit/project_node_to_type_expr_json_bytes. Spans are not identity keys (host listSymbols is SFC-absolute UTF-8; CSS matches are UTF-16).

operations.route: VerterHost.upsert + compileRequest (runtimeClient with source maps + analysis)
operations.note: compiler-substrate session already Portable as playground.compile-carrier; this row proves the same host runs in a dedicated worker
execution proof only; DX0 class stays NativeOnly until a producer-owned Portable port

metrics.artifactBytes: measured live by the gate from packages/wasm/wasm/verter_wasm_bg.wasm
metrics.startupMs: worker start to first probe postMessage, per engine
metrics.retainedMemory: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize on Chromium; labelled unavailable on Firefox/WebKit
metrics.notClaimed: no general performance claim; WSP equal-work binds to BWH11/VSW5

census.command: cargo tree --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p verter_wasm -e normal --prefix none

receiptBasis.sourceRevisions: the probe fixture bytes registered into the in-memory virtual workspace

receiptBasis.engineIdentity: none (Verter compiler/session WASM); TypeInfo is the session substrate, not typescript@6.0.3
receiptBasis.hostIdentity: browser worker plus WASM build selector
receiptBasis.completenessState: complete for the five representative operations when the gate passes; unsupported remains the DX0 NativeOnly rows this node does not admit
